CustomObject.description: How AgentLlm runs one prompt. The record's name is the prompt name (the static resource AgentPrompt_<name>): the model, the maximum length, the source (the prompt file through the Models API, the default, or a prompt template), the template and its input map, and the prompt trace. A prompt with no record runs as before. Edited by the team that tunes the prompts (docs/research/fr2-model-door.md).
